This '''[[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' was a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] and the leader of a gang of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and other criminals operating in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The gang smuggled strange ceremonial pharmaceutics, including organs of local fauna and Naboo flora, to primitive cultures of the Outer Rims that believed that fangs of the [[tusk cat]] of Naboo and others had mystic properties.

C. [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], agents of [[Kwilaan Starport/Legends|Kwilaan Starport]] identified the Omwati shaman entering a fortress. They reported to the Kwilaan portmaster, who in turn hired a team to attack the base. However, the shaman escaped.

The shaman then turned to kidnapping and left with a prisoner, a girl from a rural settlement. The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] discovered this and they initiated a search along with the local police and the community, but they failed. Then, the RSF hired an independent team to attack the hideouts associated with the shaman.
